event_records.description: Nurse Karolina posts a request in the ward's swap channel asking someone to take her Sunday night shift.

nurse_karolina.name: Nurse Karolina
nurse_karolina.persona_brief:
You are Nurse Karolina.
Karolina wants someone to take her Sunday night shift. She has posted a request in the ward's swap channel. She is aware of the Friday 15:00 rota lock deadline.

colleagues_in_the_ward.name: Colleagues in the ward
colleagues_in_the_ward.persona_brief:
You are Colleagues in the ward.
The colleagues are nurses who can see the swap channel. They may be interested in picking up extra shifts or swapping, but have no prior commitment to Karolina's request.

resolution.question: Nurse Karolina posted in her ward's swap channel asking someone to take her Sunday night shift. Will a colleague claim it before the rota locks Friday at 15:00?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that a colleague claimed the shift (e.g., by posting a reply or updating the rota) before Friday 15:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
